evidence: Most negatives are well paired: render gate wrong password vs Gwen sign-in; constraints gate cross-browser readback; functional signin_and_client_scope Part A labels its positive controls before signed-out replays; wall_every_route leg 1 pairs 'nothing from M-12' with 'shows M-11 and M-13' and leg 2 pairs empty searches with 'Survey booked' found; timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release, edits_and_stale_edit, deleted_and_expired_messages, safe_formatting, search_and_transcript Part C and persistence step c all state explicit positive controls; polish delete_confirm pairs decline with confirm, refusal_in_place pairs refusal with correct sign-in. Defect: functional/judge.toml:93 (wall_added_live leg 1) 'In Sian's page, without reloading, within about ten seconds M-12 disappears from her list and its thread stops showing messages or says it is not available' is a hide check with no matching success case: unlike wall_every_route leg 1 (judge.toml:62) it never requires Sian's other matters to remain listed/openable. The task functional prompt also replaced the template's general rule 'A positive control must come before every negative claim' (template functional/prompt.md:56) with a refusal-only rule (task prompt.md:51-52 'Every refusal pairs with a success...'), so the judge has no fallback instruction for hide legs. Legs 2-4 (judge.toml:94-96) are refusals/reload readbacks and do not prove Sian's live page still works. Minor (P3, same pattern): persistence step c (judge.toml:276) 'Sian gets not-available for M-11' has no in-criterion control that Sian still sees M-13; signin_and_client_scope Part B (judge.toml:50) replays Harriet's M-12 load and the M-12 transcript address without stating that Harriet's load/transcript succeeded. Polish escape_closes (polish/judge.toml:35) credits 'without saving' without a save control, but its credit rests on the positive 'box closes' observable, so Note only. Design-level review; no weak-app discrimination run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope).
counterexample: A submission whose client, on the next poll after Harriet walls Sian, gets 'not available' for the open M-12 thread and either throws (blank page) or treats it as session loss and drops to the sign-in screen; or whose server, while any wall exists for a user, returns not-available for all matters. Leg 1 holds (M-12 is gone from screen, thread shows nothing), legs 2-3 are refused correctly by the server, and leg 4 holds because after the lift and a reload Sian sees M-12 again. wall_added_live (weight 2.0) passes although the brief requires 'Our staff see every matter except the ones they are walled from' and 'make sure nothing breaks'.
suggested_fix: In wall_added_live leg 1 add the paired success: 'while M-11 and M-13 stay in her list and opening M-11 still shows its messages without signing in again (positive control)'; optionally restore the template's general 'positive control before every negative claim' line in functional/prompt.md and add 'Sian still opens M-13' to persistence step c.
